unsupported: CTI Industrial Supply was founded in 1987 in Las Vegas, Nevada, and has since expanded to a second retail location in Richardson, Texas.
The company began as a distributor of industrial, safety, and auto body supplies, later adding auto paint and car care products to its lineup.

Customers include auto body shops, industrial maintenance teams, woodworking shops, and professional detailers who rely on the distributor for safety equipment, refinishing materials, and specialty coatings.
The Richardson location serves the Dallas‑Fort Worth metro area while the Las Vegas headquarters covers the Southwest.
